sections.heading: Why Choose It?
sections.text:
Green Aventurine Crystal Chips: Known for luck, prosperity, growth, opportunity, and heart-healing energy.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 24K Gold Tone Rice Chain: Gives the bracelet a premium, polished, and luxurious jewellery look.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Alchemy Crystal Design: A meaningful crystal bracelet designed for positive energy, abundance, and everyday styling.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Secure Lobster Lock Closure: Easy to wear and helps keep the bracelet comfortably fitted on the wrist.

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
Wear the Alchemy Green Aventurine Crystal Rice Chain Bracelet around your wrist as a crystal-infused jewellery piece.
Secure the lobster lock properly and adjust it comfortably with the extension chain.
Wear it solo for a clean premium look or pair it with a watch and other bracelets for layered styling.
Use it for daily wear, office looks, casual outfits, festive wear, party styling, or gifting.
While wearing, set your intention for luck, growth, prosperity, positivity, and heart-balanced energy.
Avoid direct contact with water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals to maintain its shine and finish.
After use, wipe gently with a soft dry cloth and store separately in a pouch or jewellery box.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Add a fresh, elegant touch to your everyday stack with the Green Aventurine Crystal Rice Chain Bracelet. A polished golden rice-style chain meets a cluster of naturally shaped Green Aventurine crystal chips, striking a perfect balance between modern luxury and earthy charm.
Every soft green chip carries its own natural variation in colour, shape and texture, so no two bracelets ever look exactly alike. The sleek gold-tone links give it a premium, contemporary finish, while the adjustable extension chain and secure lobster clasp let it settle comfortably on any wrist.
Light on the skin and easy to layer, it slips effortlessly from workday to festive evenings and makes a thoughtful, meaningful gift.
Key features

• Natural Green Aventurine crystal chips — each one unique

• Premium gold-tone rice-style chain

• Adjustable extension with a secure lobster clasp

• Lightweight and comfortable for all-day wear

• Pairs beautifully with both western and ethnic outfits

Crystal meaning
Green Aventurine is traditionally known as the stone of opportunity, growth and positivity — often worn as a symbol of confidence, emotional balance and good fortune.
Styling suggestion
Pair it with pastel outfits, white dresses, green ethnic wear or minimal golden jewellery for a fresh, graceful look.

 FAQ

Yes, it is a meaningful gift for crystal lovers, jewellery lovers, and anyone who likes luck and prosperity-inspired accessories.

Q7. How should I care for it?

Avoid water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals. Wipe gently after use and store separately.
